\section[kaṭikāram]{\ta{கடிகாரம்} (kaṭikāram) — a clock}

\label{lesson:TA-C121-katikaram}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for a pen, then the Tamil for paper.

Tell the time, \textbf{\ta{ஒரு} \ta{மணி}}, \textbf{\ta{இரண்டு} \ta{மணி}}, then name the afternoon three ways: \textbf{\ta{நடுப்பகல்}}, \textbf{\ta{மதியம்}}, \textbf{\ta{பிற்பகல்}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{கடிகாரம்}}
\textbf{\ta{கடிகாரம்}} — \emph{kaṭikāram} — \textquotedblleft{}a clock\textquotedblright{}.

\section[(dialogue)]{Places and what you can do — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R121-first-pass-places-and-what-you-can-do}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for lentils and a curry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item straight ahead, near, distance; far, behind, in front
  \item in the middle, a street, a bridge, a park, a temple
  \item a library, a bank, a market, a beach, an office
  \item a garden, a corner, a turn, can, a skill
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Straight ahead? (\textbf{\ta{நேராக}}, \emph{nērāka}.) Near? (\textbf{\ta{அருகில்}}, \emph{arukil}.) Distance; far? (\textbf{\ta{தூரம்}}, \emph{tūram}.) Behind? (\textbf{\ta{பின்னால்}}, \emph{piṉṉāl}.) In front? (\textbf{\ta{முன்னால்}}, \emph{muṉṉāl}.) In the middle? (\textbf{\ta{நடுவில்}}, \emph{naṭuvil}.) A street? (\textbf{\ta{தெரு}}, \emph{teru}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\ta{பாலம்}}, \emph{pālam}.) A park? (\textbf{\ta{பூங்கா}}, \emph{pūṅkā}.) A temple? (\textbf{\ta{கோயில்}}, \emph{kōyil}.) A library? (\textbf{\ta{நூலகம்}}, \emph{nūlakam}.) A bank? (\textbf{\ta{வங்கி}}, \emph{vaṅki}.) A market? (\textbf{\ta{சந்தை}}, \emph{cantai}.) A beach? (\textbf{\ta{கடற்கரை}}, \emph{kaṭaṟkarai}.) An office? (\textbf{\ta{அலுவலகம்}}, \emph{aluvalakam}.) A garden? (\textbf{\ta{தோட்டம்}}, \emph{tōṭṭam}.) A corner? (\textbf{\ta{மூலை}}, \emph{mūlai}.) A turn? (\textbf{\ta{திருப்பம்}}, \emph{tiruppam}.) Can? (\textbf{\ta{முடியும்}}, \emph{muṭiyum}.) A skill? (\textbf{\ta{திறமை}}, \emph{tiṟamai}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R121-second-pass-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for ability and a right.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item ability, a right, a chance, a tool, a possession
  \item a stove, a vessel, a plate, a cup, a spoon
  \item a key, a lock, a towel; a piece, a pillow, a blanket
  \item a mirror; glasses, soap, a bucket, a pen, paper
  \item a clock, a skirt, a sari, lentils, a curry
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Ability? (\textbf{\ta{வல்லமை}}, \emph{vallamai}.) A right? (\textbf{\ta{உரிமை}}, \emph{urimai}.) A chance? (\textbf{\ta{வாய்ப்பு}}, \emph{vāyppu}.) A tool? (\textbf{\ta{கருவி}}, \emph{karuvi}.) A possession? (\textbf{\ta{உடைமை}}, \emph{uṭaimai}.) A stove? (\textbf{\ta{அடுப்பு}}, \emph{aṭuppu}.) A vessel? (\textbf{\ta{பாத்திரம்}}, \emph{pāttiram}.) A plate? (\textbf{\ta{தட்டு}}, \emph{taṭṭu}.) A cup? (\textbf{\ta{கோப்பை}}, \emph{kōppai}.) A spoon? (\textbf{\ta{கரண்டி}}, \emph{karaṇṭi}.) A key? (\textbf{\ta{சாவி}}, \emph{cāvi}.) A lock? (\textbf{\ta{பூட்டு}}, \emph{pūṭṭu}.) A towel; a piece? (\textbf{\ta{துண்டு}}, \emph{tuṇṭu}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\ta{தலையணை}}, \emph{talaiyaṇai}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\ta{போர்வை}}, \emph{pōrvai}.) A mirror; glasses? (\textbf{\ta{கண்ணாடி}}, \emph{kaṇṇāṭi}.) Soap? (\textbf{\ta{சோப்பு}}, \emph{cōppu}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\ta{வாளி}}, \emph{vāḷi}.) A pen? (\textbf{\ta{பேனா}}, \emph{pēṉā}.) Paper? (\textbf{\ta{காகிதம்}}, \emph{kāgitam}.) A clock? (\textbf{\ta{கடிகாரம்}}, \emph{kaṭikāram}.) A skirt? (\textbf{\ta{பாவாடை}}, \emph{pāvāṭai}.) A sari? (\textbf{\ta{சேலை}}, \emph{cēlai}.) Lentils? (\textbf{\ta{பருப்பு}}, \emph{paruppu}.) A curry? (\textbf{\ta{குழம்பு}}, \emph{kuḻambu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
